Commentary: Sri Lanka Squad: Lahiru Udara, Pasindu Sooriyabandara, Dinesh Chandimal, Dhananjaya de Silva, Kusal Mendis(w/c), Kamindu Mendis, Sonal Dinusha, Milan Priyanath Rathnayake, Keshara Nuwantha, Lahiru Kumara, Dilshan Madushanka, Eshan Malinga, Prabath Jayasuriya, Anjala Bandara, Asitha Fernando

Pakistan Squad: Azan Awais, Sameer Minhas, Babar Azam(c), Tayyab Arif, Saud Shakeel, Salman Agha, Ghazi Ghori(w), Razaullah, Mohammad Abbas, Mohammad Taha, Ali Shabbir, Mohammad Suleman, Aamer Jamal, Arafat Minhas, Saad Baig, Saqib Khan
Squads:
Lahiru Kumara to Babar Azam, no run, length delivery outside off, Babar Azam gets forward and shoulders arms
Dilshan Madushanka to Mohammad Taha, no run, good length outside off, in the corridor of uncertainty, Mohammad Taha gets forward and shoulders arms
Dilshan Madushanka to Mohammad Taha, 1 run, full and angled in on middle, Mohammad Taha shuffles across and flicks wide of mid-wicket
Dilshan Madushanka to Babar Azam, no run, short of length outside off, from round the wicket, comes back in a tad, Babar Azam shoulders arms
Dilshan Madushanka to Babar Azam, no run, full and angled in on off, Babar Azam gets forward to defend, the thick outside edge is found and rolls to gully
Just two slips and a gully.

Dilshan Madushanka to Babar Azam, no run, full outside off, Babar Azam went for the big cover-drive and the thick inside half finds mid-on. Babar has a look at the bat and shadow-practices the cover-drive after missing out
Dilshan Madushanka to Babar Azam, no run, full and angled in on off, Babar Azam with a solid forward defence to cover
Lahiru Kumara to Mohammad Taha, no run, short of length on off, angled in, Mohammad Taha goes on the back foot and defends solidly
Should be the last over before lunch.

Lahiru Kumara to Mohammad Taha, no run, full and angled in on off, Mohammad Taha gets forward and defends to mid-off. A grunt from Lahiru Kumara after delivery showing how much effort he is putting in
Lahiru Kumara to Mohammad Taha, no run, full and angled in on off, Mohammad Taha gets forward to defend, the bottom-hand comes off as it rolls to the left of the bowler
Lahiru Kumara to Mohammad Taha, no run, back of a length outside off, shapes away, rising, left alone
Lahiru Kumara grunting after every delivery. He seems to be putting in that extra effort.

Lahiru Kumara to Mohammad Taha, no run, back of a length on middle and leg, Mohammad Taha goes on the back foot to defend it back down the track. That kept a tad low as well but Taha is right behind that
A chat between the batters.
Lahiru Kumara to Mohammad Taha, no run, full on off, Mohammad Taha gets forward to drive to the right of mid-off. Was an easy single but they don't take it. That will be lunch as well

With four seamers being picked and no spinner except for the part-time offspin of DdS and the SLA of Kamindu Mendis (he's ambidextrous - can bowl right-arm offspin too), Sri Lanka need to bowl Pakistan out under 300 to justify their decision to bowl first. As of now, it's Pakistan who will be the happier side. We will be back in 30 minutes for the post-lunch session....

My colleague - Akshay Maanay who keeps an eagle-eye on all matches on comms on this platform informs that Sonal Dinusha is the one who would be preferred more than Kamindu Mendis as a spinner. And Dinusha bowled a lot during his debut series.
Welcome back for the 2nd session...
Dilshan Madushanka to Babar Azam, no run, full and tailing in from round the wicket, Azam pushes it to covers
Dilshan Madushanka to Babar Azam, FOUR, to extra cover

Dilshan Madushanka to Babar Azam, FOUR, one more, this time it was short and wide outside off, Azam rides the bounces well and flays it on the up to deep extra cover, 50 stand up between these two and it has come at the quick time
Back to over the wicket now
Dilshan Madushanka to Babar Azam, no run, back of a length and angling across, Azam punches it to covers
Dilshan Madushanka to Babar Azam, FOUR, between extra cover and long-off
Dilshan Madushanka to Babar Azam, 2 runs, to sweeper cover
Lahiru Kumara [6.0-1-32-0] is back into the attack
Lahiru Kumara to Mohammad Taha, 1 run, angling into the pads from round the wicket, Taha clips it to backward square leg
Lahiru Kumara to Babar Azam, no run, good length delivery angling in from outside off, Azam gets forward and leaves it alone
Lahiru Kumara to Babar Azam, 1 run, square of the wicket
